identity.description: Reducto is an AI document-processing company whose API parses, extracts, splits, classifies and edits documents (PDFs, scans, etc.). Its docs live at docs.reducto.ai and the product site is reducto.ai.
identity.identity_notes: Vendor docs at docs.reducto.ai and the reducto.ai pricing page describe the same document-parsing product (Parse, Extract, Edit, Split APIs). Matches the assignment hint reducto.ai (document parsing).

auth.oauth_flows: Local MCP server only: `uvx mcp-server-reducto --login` runs a browser-based OAuth device-code flow (per docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server). No OAuth flow documented for the REST API.
auth.scopes_notes: No scopes documented for the REST API key. Not established from sources.

access.production_restrictions: Standard plan gives $150 of free usage, then list (pay-as-you-go) rates apply. Growth and Enterprise use custom pricing via Contact sales. Whether production use needs review is not established.

api.rate_limits: No numeric limits found. The 429 error row says: "Too many concurrent requests. Retry with backoff." and links to a Rate Limits page not read.
api.limitations: Processing-oriented API: the write endpoints are document-processing jobs rather than CRUD on persistent resources. Async endpoints take a webhook parameter; no separate webhook endpoint or payload/retry docs were found. Base URL https://platform.reducto.ai is from search summaries and the cURL example in docs.
